title: Squad

empty.text: No squad yet. Squads keep it up better.

visibility: Your squad sees whether you are focusing now, how long your session still runs and whether you met your daily goal. They don't see your focus minutes and points, unless you turn on comparing minutes yourself. Silent mode hides your status; you still count for the squad day.

create.title: Create squad
create.intro: Focus together. Squads keep it up better.
create.name: Name of your squad
create.name_hint: 2 to 40 characters. Anyone who sees the name can report it.

streak.label: Squad streak
streak.value: {count, plural, =0 {No streak yet} one {# day} other {# days}}
streak.building: {count, plural, one {# more friend} other {# more friends}} needed. Meanwhile you just focus.
streak.frozen: You have fewer than 3 active members. The streak pauses until there are 3 again.
streak.recovery: Get your streak back with two days in a row.
streak.recovery_detail: If you do, the streak is back at {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}.

today.line: Today: {met} of {active} active members met their daily goal.
today.success: The squad day is a success.

presence.remaining: Someone is focusing now ({count, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}} left)
presence.label: Who is focusing now

joker.used: Joker this week: used. You counted for the squad day.

belofte.own: Your Promise: {met} of {target} days this week.
belofte.promised: {name} promised {days} days a week, {minutes} minutes, until {date}.

compare.title: Compare minutes
compare.off: Comparing minutes is off. Turn it on in Me; you only see members who turned it on too.
compare.none: Nobody else has comparing minutes on yet.

actions.leave_text: From tomorrow you no longer count in this squad. Your points and your Promise stay.

invite.title: Invite
invite.text: I'm focusing with Rewarded in a squad. Phones down, squad up. Join me?
invite.validity: This link is valid for 7 days, for at most 5 friends.
invite.no_share: Sharing from your phone doesn't work here. Copy the link and paste it into WhatsApp.

report.title: Report name
report.text: Is this squad name inappropriate? A person at Rewarded will look at it.
report.sent: Thanks. We'll look at the name.
